comments.quote: Perched on the mountainside, the hotel offers expansive and incredibly pleasant views. The service is top-notch, with staff always going the extra mile for guests. We had a very comfortable stay and would definitely consider returning on our next visit.

comments.quote: This place has a wonderfully unique mountain home feel. Perched on the mountain, it offers breathtaking views of the peaks across the valley. Having breakfast while enjoying that mountain panorama was pure bliss! Definitely worth a return visit!
